articles.title: Why has Brittany Mahomes stopped posing warmly with Patrick Mahomes’ younger brother Jackson Mahomes
articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes used to be a frequent visitor on her brother-in-law Jackson Mahomes’ Instagram account.
articles.body: Brittany Mahomes used to be a frequent visitor on her brother-in-law Jackson Mahomes’ Instagram account.However, since the 2026 NFL season began, Patrick Mahomes’ brother hasn’t posted any photos with the mother of three. Even his most recent IG post features one of Brittany’s children rather than Brittany herself.While Brittany appeared in nearly every other photo from June 2019 until September 2025, she has rarely been featured since. Currently, only a few pictures on his Instagram include her, and in those, she appears alongside the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback, his mother Randi Mahomes, and his half-sister Mia Randall.Brittany Mahomes and Jackson Mahomes’ changing relationshipBrittany Mahomes went from wearing the brightest smile while posing with Jackson Mahomes to sporting a subtle, “not-interested-in-posing-with-you” look over the course of six years.On the other hand, Jackson’s smile never changed in the slightest; he looks just as radiant as he did in their very first photo together. However, Brittany’s shifting attitude toward her brother-in-law is now impossible to miss.He was there helping her choose her wedding dress, celebrating her birthdays, and helping take care of her kids. But now? Suddenly, everything has changed.Fans were so used to seeing them together that when Jackson appeared to hard-launch his relationship with Shyanne Blankenship on Instagram, one user commented, “Ain’t that Brittany Mahomes?”Another wrote, “Looks like big bro’s wife,” while a third added, “Resemble Brittany.” A fourth user simply asked, “Why does that look like Brittany?” That is just how frequently the two used to post together.Maybe his Kansas City influencer girlfriend dislikes him posing with his brother’s wife on Instagram, though that is pure speculation. Ultimately, anything could explain the drop in posts.Alternatively, maybe Brittany disapproves of Jackson dating Shyanne Blankenship, leading her to stop posing with him with her signature bright smile.Jackson’s 2021 birthday post for Brittany read, “HBD to my bestie/sidekick and future sister. Loved celebrating you.” If Brittany was once that close to him, maybe she dislikes his current girlfriend - or maybe she is simply too busy managing three children and several multimillion-dollar business ventures.Or did that viral 2024 Super Bowl party video have something to do with a potential fallout? Jackson appeared to be denied entry into a VIP section during a Future concert in Las Vegas, right where his sister-in-law was standing.When the security guard blocked Jackson, he looked in Brittany’s direction, seemingly hoping she would intervene. Instead, she shrugged and kept dancing.Or did Kayla Nicole have something to do with the fallout between the two?Brittany Mahomes’ constant presence on Jackson Mahomes’ InstagramEvery year, the wife of the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback has appeared alongside members of the Mahomes family at football games and several of their celebrations.Jackson has shared updates and personal moments from those celebrations with his Instagram followers, maintaining a strong social media presence over the past six years.He has also posed with Kayla Nicole, Travis Kelce’s ex-girlfriend and Brittany’s former close friend. Their previous public appearances have included family celebrations and football-related events.In May 2025, Jackson reposted Brittany’s Instagram story, in which the NFL WAG posed in a risque, one-shouldered dress and sat alongside her friend Miranda and Jackson. She captioned it, “Happy Birthdayyyy!!!!! [Jackson Mahomes].”Jackson Mahomes’ Instagram posts spark rift speculationBeing part of a high-profile NFL family means even slight changes in social media activity attract widespread public scrutiny.Patrick Mahomes’ career with the Kansas City Chiefs has kept the Mahomes family in the spotlight for nearly a decade. On the other hand, Brittany Mahomes has created her own public profile through business ventures, fitness, and lifestyle content on her social media account.Consequently, a smaller number of joint photos cannot reliably measure family closeness or indicate a rift. There may be nothing wrong at all; relatives often remain close without regularly appearing together online.However, Brittany’s lack of expected presence in Jackson Mahomes’ Instagram posts does spark rift speculation.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Travis Kelce earns high praise from Operation Breakthrough students: “this sort of groundedness you wouldn’t expect to see in a lot of NFL players”
articles.summary: In January 2026, Operation Breakthrough students gave Travis Kelce heartfelt praise for his down-to-earth nature and continued involvement in their lives.
articles.body: In January 2026, Operation Breakthrough students gave Travis Kelce heartfelt praise for his down-to-earth nature and continued involvement in their lives. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end made an everlasting impression on these students through his humble interactions.He offered encouraging words, memorable experiences, and opportunities beyond football. These students highlighted how the 11-time Pro Bowler’s willingness to listen patiently and join in their day-to-day activities helped them feel deeply valued and loved.One student summed up Kelce’s personality, saying, “This sort of groundedness you wouldn’t expect to see in a lot of NFL players.” Because Kelce wasn’t talking about his football stats; he was trying to understand how the student’s school day went.Travis Kelce’s Operation Breakthrough involvementOne student said Travis Kelce had been involved with Operation Breakthrough for as long as they could remember. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end participated in robotics competitions and casual pizza celebrations after robotics practice.Another student recalled how Kelce gave them a Super Bowl ticket in 2025. That experience became a memorable moment. It changed their perspective and gave them a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to travel to another state. They experienced the new culture and witnessed the much-celebrated event in person.Some of the students recalled personal encounters with the NFL megastar. One met Travis Kelce at a mall. They filmed a video with him at Champs. Also invited him to eat pizza for dinner. Kelce, without a flinch, wholeheartedly accepted the invitation.Travis Kelce supports young studentsThe three-time Super Bowl champion’s interest in children extends beyond participation in Operation Breakthrough activities.One student remembered being unexpectedly approached by Travis Kelce. Kelce enquired about his grades. The question made the student nervous at first, but it also showed Kelce’s interest in children’s academic progress. The student felt special because an important person wanted to know their grades.One student recalled how Kelce shared his personal experience with them. The NFL superstar helped them understand how to handle adversity both on the field and in everyday life.Sharing his experience of being under constant public scrutiny, he explained how he manages that pressure while staying as authentic as possible. One student spoke very highly of Kelce.The student credited him for encouraging a positive attitude towards life. It’s important to approach situations with a good attitude so possibilities can appear even from life’s challenges.Operation Breakthrough creates career opportunitiesThe students who praised Travis Kelce also praised the several opportunities available through the nonprofit organization Operation Breakthrough.One student spoke about graphic design, how it became an influential field, and how it gave them a vision for their future career.It helped them with never-considered-before possibilities. The student’s experience speaks volumes about how exposure to different career fields can help youth understand their individual interests, develop skills, and explore future career paths.Travis Kelce’s humility wins students’ praiseOne student was highly impressed by Travis Kelce’s humility. The student said the NFL star wasn’t interested in sharing his latest football game statistics, but preferred hearing about their school day or how their academic year was going.This small detail changed the student’s perspective on NFL players. “This sort of groundedness you wouldn’t expect to see in a lot of NFL players,” the student said.For these students, Kelce is known not just for his NFL achievements, but for his willingness to connect with youth in ways most players don’t. He connects with them on a personal level, encourages their ambitions, and makes them feel heard, valued, and loved.This genuine character earned high praise from Kelce’s newest teammate, who recently commended the Kansas City Chiefs tight end.Mansoor Delane admires Travis Kelce’s auraThe Kansas City Chiefs rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane recently heavily praised Travis Kelce. The New Heights podcast’s X account shared a clip admiring the veteran Chiefs tight end.The video candidly captures Delane telling his other Kansas City teammate by the sideline, “He [Travis]’s got so much aura, bro. Kelce has so much aura. Like if I had a son, I’d want him to be just like him.”This genuine remark reflects the respect Kelce’s young teammate feels for him, proving that his influence extends far beyond his gridiron achievements.Delane’s comment, along with the high praise from Operation Breakthrough students, speaks volumes about Kelce’s character and how he connects with people both inside and outside the Kansas City Chiefs organization. articles.title: Aaron Rodgers’ own brother reportedly knows next to nothing about wife Brittani amid fresh family drama
articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers may have finally started putting his family drama behind him, but it looks like there are still a few awkward chapters left in the Rodgers
articles.body: Aaron Rodgers may have finally started putting his family drama behind him, but it looks like there are still a few awkward chapters left in the Rodgers family story. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback's long-awaited reunion with his family was supposed to mark a fresh start. However, a new report is raising questions about just how close everyone really is, especially when it comes to his younger brother, Jordan Rodgers, and his mystery wife, Brittani.Aaron Rodgers’ family reunion not so picture-perfect? Brother Jordan reportedly knows little about mystery wifeAccording to a new report, an insider claims that Jordan and his wife, JoJo Fletcher, don't seem to know much about Brittani. The source also hinted that the relationship between the brothers might not be completely back on track, despite their recent efforts to reconnect.And honestly, that detail makes this family reunion story even more interesting. Aaron has credited Brittani with helping him open the door to reconciliation, yet his brother's reported lack of familiarity with her suggests that the family's journey toward healing could be more complicated than it looks.Aaron's relationship with his family has been a topic of conversation for years. The quarterback's estrangement from his parents and siblings became public knowledge during Jordan's appearance on The Bachelorette in 2016, when Jordan spoke about their distant relationship.For a long time, there were few signs of a meaningful reconciliation. That began to change this year, when Aaron shared glimpses of spending time with his parents and older brother, Luke.The quarterback later opened up about reconnecting with Jordan, too. During an appearance on Cam Heyward's Not Just Football podcast in September, Aaron confirmed that the brothers had met and described their conversation as a tough one.Brittani is perhaps the most intriguing person in this story because Aaron has kept his marriage largely out of the public eye. Aaron confirmed that he was married in June 2025, but has deliberately kept details about his wife private. Unlike many celebrity couples, the two have largely avoided sharing their relationship with the world.Aaron has credited Brittani with helping him become more open to repairing his family relationships. Her encouragement reportedly played a role in his decision to reconnect with his parents and siblings after years of estrangement.That's what makes the insider's claim about Jordan and JoJo particularly interesting. If the report is accurate, Aaron's wife has been an important figure in his reconciliation journey, while his younger brother's household apparently remains unfamiliar with her.Earlier reporting also indicated that Jordan and JoJo did not attend Aaron's wedding. However, neither that absence nor the latest insider comments independently prove that Brittani is the reason behind any lingering tension.Jordan Rodgers has shown public support for his brotherDespite their complicated history, Jordan hasn't appeared entirely disconnected from Aaron.Jordan publicly defended his brother's football performance during an appearance on ESPN's First Take in September, praising Aaron's play and discussing the expectations surrounding the Steelers.Jordan also liked a family post shared by their older brother Luke after a Steelers gathering, even though he wasn't pictured with the group. Those gestures don't reveal what is happening behind closed doors, but they do offer a more nuanced picture than a simple story of two brothers falling out all over again.Jordan and JoJo also have their own lives and commitments, making it difficult to draw conclusions from their absence at a family gathering. For now, Aaron's reconciliation appears to be a work in progress. And while the mystery surrounding Brittani continues to fuel curiosity, the latest claims remain based on an unnamed insider rather than direct confirmation from the Rodgers family.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Ja’Marr Chase wins attention for complimenting JD Vance’s son as other Bengals' players seemingly ignored him
articles.summary: Vice President JD Vance's visit to the Cincinnati Bengals' practice facility has sparked an unexpected conversation, and Ja’Marr Chase has found himself
articles.body: Vice President JD Vance's visit to the Cincinnati Bengals' practice facility has sparked an unexpected conversation, and Ja’Marr Chase has found himself at the center of it. While several Bengals players appeared to walk past the vice president without engaging with him, the star wide receiver reportedly shared a brief but friendly moment with Vance's family. The interaction was more special because Chase complimented the gloves worn by Vance's son. According to Vance's communications director, Taylor Van Kirk, the moment made the vice president's son, Vivek, particularly happy. The small exchange stood out amid footage of Bengals players seemingly keeping their distance from Vance during the visit.Ja’Marr Chase’s interaction with JD Vance’s son steals the spotlightChase's reported compliment about the gloves gave the visit a wholesome moment amid the online debate. While the interaction itself was brief, it became a talking point because of the contrast with other players' apparent lack of engagement.Footage from the visit showed players walking by Vance, with tight end Drew Sample among those who stopped to acknowledge him. Sample was seen fist-bumping Vance's son and briefly shaking the vice president's hand.Chase's interaction, meanwhile, attracted attention after Van Kirk highlighted the compliment in her post, offering a glimpse into a more personal side of the visit. The interaction has also prompted speculation about Chase's political views, with some social media users interpreting his friendly exchange as a sign of respect for President Donald Trump.However, a compliment directed at someone's child is not necessarily a political statement. Similarly, while the footage has fueled claims that almost every other Bengals player ignored Vance, the brief clips do not establish what every player thought or whether anyone deliberately snubbed the vice president.The contrasting interactions have given fans another reason to debate the intersection of sports and politics. For some, Chase's friendly gesture was simply a polite moment involving a young fan. For others, the difference in players' reactions became the bigger story.Still, the clearest takeaway from the visit may be the simplest one: Chase's reported compliment made Vance's son happy, and that brief exchange ended up drawing attention far beyond the practice facility. For now, any suggestion that the moment reveals Chase's political loyalties remains speculation.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: 49ers’ perfect DeForest Buckner trade offer to Colts before NFL trade deadline
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers should offer the Indianapolis Colts a 2027 third-round pick for DeForest Buckner before the November 10 NFL trade deadline. That is a...
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers should offer the Indianapolis Colts a 2027 third-round pick for DeForest Buckner before the November 10 NFL trade deadline. That is a meaningful price for a 32-year-old defensive tackle, but his production and fit make a reunion worth pursuing.

This would not be about correcting an unpopular decision from six years ago. It would be about acquiring an interior difference-maker for a championship push while giving Indianapolis a valuable asset for its next roster overhaul.

Why Buckner would elevate San Francisco's defensive front

Buckner has recorded 26 tackles, four sacks and three passes defended through six games in 2026. He also has eight quarterback hits and four tackles for loss. Those numbers show a veteran still influencing possessions rather than surviving on reputation.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

That interior disruption is what San Francisco should prioritize. Edge pressure becomes more dangerous when quarterbacks cannot comfortably step forward, and Buckner can challenge guards while creating less predictable escape routes.

His arrival would also broaden the defensive coordinator's options. The 49ers could pursue pressure with four rushers more confidently, preserving additional defenders in coverage instead of depending on extra blitzers to manufacture disruption.

There is a run-defense benefit, too. Buckner's ability to penetrate can force runners to alter their paths before reaching the second level. That creates opportunities for teammates, provided the entire front maintains its gap responsibilities.

Familiarity adds appeal without eliminating the adjustment period. Buckner spent his first four NFL seasons with San Francisco, and Kyle Juszczyk has publicly encouraged him to return. Existing relationships could help his integration, although the current scheme and personnel still require study.

The contract creates urgency and risk. Buckner is in the final year of his deal, so San Francisco would be acquiring immediate help without guaranteed control beyond this season. An extension could be discussed separately, but the trade should make sense even without one.

Why Indianapolis should consider moving its defensive leader

The Colts are 2-4, making their deadline decision more complicated than simply declaring themselves contenders or sellers. Trading Buckner would weaken the defense immediately and remove an established locker-room presence.

Still, Indianapolis must weigh that loss against the possibility of watching him leave in free agency. A guaranteed third-round selection would provide a concrete return now rather than relying on an uncertain future compensatory-pick outcome.

That selection could help address several needs. The Colts could draft a replacement defender, strengthen another position or use it as part of a larger transaction. Younger contributors on rookie contracts would give the organization greater flexibility around its next core.

Financial considerations matter, but neither team should confuse Buckner's full 2026 cap charge with the amount transferred in a deadline trade. Previously paid bonus accounting and remaining compensation require separate analysis before any agreement.

The perfect offer balances impact against rental risk

The proposed package should remain straightforward:

San Francisco's 2027 third-round draft pick.

For Indianapolis, a third-rounder acknowledges that Buckner remains a premium contributor rather than a veteran being discarded. For San Francisco, it preserves first- and second-round selections while addressing an immediate need with a proven player.

The 49ers should resist adding another substantial asset unless competing bids justify it. Buckner's age and expiring contract impose a sensible ceiling, even with his strong performance.

This is the kind of calculated aggression contenders should embrace: pay for present impact, respect the long-term cost and avoid letting familiarity replace disciplined evaluation.

articles.title: Jason Kelce praises Chiefs fan for making a Caitlin Clark-style basketball shot
articles.summary: Jason Kelce praised a Kansas City Chiefs fan after a successful long-range basketball shot at a pregame tailgate on Oct. 18, 2026. The New Heights podcast co...
articles.body:
Jason Kelce had a memorable moment with Kansas City Chiefs fans ahead of the team's Oct. 18, 2026, game against the Los Angeles Chargers. During a pregame tailgate outside Arrowhead Stadium, the retired NFL center watched a fan sink an unusually long basketball shot and immediately connected the moment to WNBA star Caitlin Clark.

Kelce, who co-hosts the popular New Heights podcast with his brother, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, was interacting with fans during the event when the impressive attempt found its mark. The podcast's official social media account celebrated the moment by referencing Clark's renowned long-range shooting.

The playful comparison brought together two major sports audiences: NFL fans who gathered to support Kansas City and basketball followers familiar with Clark's ability to make shots from well beyond the three-point line. It also highlighted the growing connection between Clark and the Kelce family.

Jason Kelce's pregame event delivered an unexpected highlight

Kelce's interaction with Chiefs supporters took place during a New Heights tailgate ahead of Kansas City's matchup with the Chargers. The event gave fans an opportunity to meet the retired Philadelphia Eagles center and participate in activities before kickoff.

One basketball challenge produced the afternoon's standout moment. As a fan prepared to attempt a distant shot, Kelce provided running commentary, building anticipation as the ball traveled toward the basket.

The attempt went in, prompting an enthusiastic reaction from Kelce. Rather than treating the successful shot as an ordinary tailgate highlight, he helped turn it into a memorable moment by linking the fan's range to one of basketball's most recognizable shooters.

The fan's long-range shot earned a Caitlin Clark comparison

Kelce's commentary included the line, "Here it comes, all the way from New York City," as the fan launched the ball. The exaggerated description captured the distance involved and added to the excitement surrounding the attempt.

After the shot went through the basket, the New Heights account shared the clip with the caption, "From Caitlin Clark range." The post tagged Clark, making the Indiana Fever star part of the moment even though she was not the person taking the shot.

The comparison was a natural fit for Clark's reputation as an ambitious long-range shooter. Her ability to launch deep 3-pointers has become a defining feature of her game, making her name an easy reference for fans who have seen her connect from far away.

Caitlin Clark's shooting range has become part of her identity

Clark rose to national prominence at the University of Iowa, where her scoring ability and deep shooting helped attract unprecedented attention to women's college basketball. Her performances made long-range attempts a signature part of her on-court identity.

She carried that reputation into the WNBA with the Indiana Fever. Clark's willingness to shoot from well beyond the conventional 3-point range forces defenders to account for her farther from the basket, creating opportunities for teammates as well as herself.

The tailgate comparison was a lighthearted reference, not a claim that the fan's shot was equivalent to Clark's performance in a competitive game. Still, it illustrated how recognizable her shooting style has become beyond women's basketball.

Clark's connection to the Chiefs made the reference even better

Clark is not simply a basketball star being mentioned by an NFL personality. She has openly supported the Kansas City Chiefs for years, giving her a genuine connection to the team whose fans attended Kelce's event.

The Iowa native has discussed her Chiefs fandom publicly, and her friendship with the Kelce family has helped bring her into the team's wider circle. Her appearances alongside Taylor Swift at Chiefs games have also attracted attention.

That overlap made the reference especially fitting for a Kansas City tailgate. A basketball shot became an opportunity to recognize a player whose interests extend beyond her own sport and whose connection with the Chiefs is well established.

Jason and Travis Kelce have built a relationship with Clark

Clark previously appeared on New Heights , where she discussed basketball, her life outside the game and her enthusiasm for the Chiefs. The conversation gave listeners a chance to see her interact with the brothers beyond the usual boundaries of sports coverage.

The Kelces have also shown interest in Clark's career away from the podcast studio. Their public exchanges reflect a friendly relationship that brings together professional football, women's basketball, and the broader sports-entertainment world.

That familiarity helps explain why Clark's name came naturally into the tailgate moment. The reference was more than a random celebrity comparison; it connected a successful fan shot to a basketball player the Kelce brothers already know.

The moment highlighted the crossover between football and basketball

Professional sports audiences often overlap, particularly when athletes and personalities share interests across leagues. Clark's Chiefs fandom is one example of how a prominent basketball player can also become part of the conversation surrounding an NFL team.

Kelce's tailgate appearance provided a relaxed setting for that crossover. Fans were not watching a formal competition between professional athletes; they were participating in a pregame gathering where a spontaneous moment could become a highlight.

The clip also demonstrated how a short social media post can connect different sports communities. A fan's long shot, Kelce's enthusiastic commentary and a reference to Clark combined to make a simple activity more memorable.

The New Heights tailgate added to the Chiefs' game-day atmosphere

The New Heights event was part of the buildup to Kansas City's Oct. 18 home game against the Chargers. Kelce's presence gave attendees a chance to engage with a familiar football personality before the teams took the field.

The tailgate included fan-focused activities and a meet-and-greet opportunity with Jason Kelce. Such gatherings allow supporters to connect with sports figures in a setting that feels more personal than a stadium seat or television broadcast.

For Kelce, the basketball challenge offered an unscripted highlight amid the day's scheduled activities. The fan made the shot, Kelce supplied the excitement, and the podcast account gave the moment a memorable connection to Clark.

Clark's growing influence reaches beyond the basketball court

Clark's impact is evident not only in the attention paid to her games but also in how her name is recognized across sports. Her deep shooting has become a shorthand reference that audiences can understand even outside a basketball arena.

Her presence in the Chiefs conversation reflects the same wider appeal. As a prominent Fever player and an established Kansas City supporter, Clark can connect with fans who follow football as closely as they follow basketball.

Fun fact: Caitlin Clark's Chiefs fandom inspired the red "Sea of Red" colorway of her signature Nike Caitlin 1 basketball shoe, which Travis Kelce received as a gift from the WNBA star.

Jason Kelce praised a Chiefs fan after the supporter made a long-range basketball shot during a pregame tailgate on Oct. 18, 2026.

Kelce joked that the ball was coming from New York City as the fan attempted the shot.

The New Heights account captioned the clip, "From Caitlin Clark range," and tagged the Indiana Fever star.

Clark is a longtime Chiefs fan and has an established connection with Jason and Travis Kelce.

Clark's first signature Nike shoe, the Caitlin 1, launched on Oct. 1, 2026.

articles.title: Steelers’ Paris bar fan event’s fate sealed amid protests
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers will no longer hold their planned Steelers House gathering in Paris this weekend after recent protests prompted security concerns aro...
articles.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers will no longer hold their planned Steelers House gathering in Paris this weekend after recent protests prompted security concerns around the event's location.

Pittsburgh canceled the fan gathering at a bar in the Bastille neighborhood ahead of its Week 7 matchup against the New Orleans Saints . The decision affects the team-sponsored event but does not change plans for Sunday's game at Stade de France.

"Following recent events in the Bastille neighborhood, and after careful consideration, we felt it appropriate not to move forward with the planned Steelers House fan event in Paris," a message sent to fans read, according to The Associated Press.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

The Steelers described the decision as a precaution after the Bastille area experienced recent disruptions. Additional demonstrations could also take place in Paris and other areas of France over the weekend.

The NFL's broader activities in the city have continued without interruption. Nicki Ewell, the league's vice president for global events, told the AP that Pittsburgh made the call to cancel Steelers House. The NFL helped distribute the announcement after previously working with the team to promote the gathering.

Ewell said other NFL fan events have not been affected.

An Irish pub called O'Sullivans in the Bastille area had also advertised a watch party for Sunday's Steelers-Saints matchup.

Roger Goodell addresses security ahead of Steelers' Paris clash

The Steelers reiterated that the league continues to coordinate with local officials as preparations for the game continue.

"The NFL, as they do for every game, including international games, is working closely with local authorities and partners on all operational and security matters," the Steelers said in a statement to the AP. "As stated by the NFL, there have been no disruptions or impacts at League sites."

NFL commissioner Roger Goodell addressed the unrest Wednesday and expressed confidence that the league has taken the necessary precautions for its Paris game.

Goodell said he spoke with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, while officials have remained in communication with authorities in Paris and throughout France.

"We've made all the preparations," Goodell said. "Protests are not unusual in France, as you know, and that's something that we will be aware of and make sure that the appropriate arrangements are made."

The cancellation therefore remains limited to Pittsburgh's designated Bastille bar event rather than Sunday's game.

The Steelers enter Week 7 at 4-2, while the Saints sit at 2-4. Pittsburgh and New Orleans will meet Sunday at Stade de France, with kickoff scheduled for 9:30 a.m. ET on NFL Network.
